svg.title: Study 3 registered closing shift (P2) by model and appraisal condition
svg.desc: Source: derived/study3/study3.json per_model.P2.A0 and .A1 (mean, ci90, ci95, d_i, reading); every d_i re-derived from the six session runs' games and checked. Fixture dots jittered vertically.
svg.text: Dots: 40 fixtures. Thick: 90% CI; thin: 95% CI. Band: ±0.10 equivalence margin (H2).
d = mean over openers of [seller share at $100M − at $100] (surplus units)
A0: no appraisal (model colour, filled); A1: appraisal shown (grey, open). Equivalent: 90% CI inside ±0.10;
small shift: equivalent but H1 rejects zero (Holm). Agreements only; 40 fixtures per row.
